note: PalmNet neural palmprint model (MobileNetV3-Small + ArcFace, 256-d embedding), trained and verified in PalmNet-Bench (~/workspace/palmnet-bench). Stored as base64 text parts because the repo snapshot-push channel carries UTF-8 text only; the app fetches the parts, concatenates, base64-decodes and verifies length + SHA-256 before creating the ONNX session. The original two-file export (palmnet.onnx + palmnet.onnx.data, 4,583,023 B) produces bit-identical embeddings to this single-file inline (verified max abs diff 0.0 on EVAL ROIs).
